box_level.note_confusion_matrix: Ultralytics matrix from the test-split val run (conf=0.001, IoU 0.45). Rows = predicted class, columns = true class; last row/column = background (missed objects / unmatched predictions). It counts every detection above conf 0.001, so the background column is dominated by low-confidence detections; read class-vs-class cells, not the background column.

note_coco: COCO has no head/helmet/vest classes, so box-level AP is 0 by construction; the image-level proxy flags an image when COCO sees a person.
